steps.title: Earth's axial tilt
steps.say: Seasons are caused by Earth's tilted axis, which stays pointed in the same direction as Earth orbits the Sun.

steps.title: Northern winter
steps.say: In December, the Northern Hemisphere tilts away from the Sun, receiving indirect sunlight and shorter days, which creates winter.

steps.title: Spring equinox
steps.say: Three months later at the equinox, neither hemisphere is tilted toward the Sun, so both receive equal day and night.

steps.title: Northern summer
steps.say: By June, the Northern Hemisphere tilts toward the Sun, getting direct rays and long days, causing summer.

steps.title: Your turn: find Northern Summer
steps.say: Can you drag Earth along its orbit to where the Northern Hemisphere experiences summer?

steps.title: Explore the seasons
steps.say: Notice how the sunlight angle changes across the year. Drag Earth freely around the orbit to see how the seasons change!
